title: Data Structures Practice 1
statement:
Module 4 (Data Structures) covers: forms and validation, tables advanced, html and javascript hooks, svg and canvas, project: build a page, html templates and components. Solve this practice problem using what you learned.

Exercise 1: write a small program that demonstrates one concept from this module (Forms and Validation).
hints: Re-read the Forms and Validation lesson example.
Start by declaring your variables, then add the core logic.
Test with the simplest input first, then edge cases.
solutionExplanation: A correct solution applies the module concepts in a small working program.
